items.t: Said the inclusion of exemptions on firearms was tied to a 2024 constitutional amendment establishing the right to hunt and fish.
items.q: Duggan said the inclusion of exemptions on firearms was tied to a constitutional amendment passed by voters in 2024 establishing the right to hunt and fish in the Florida constitution.

items.t: Said mobile home residents would functionally get the Save Our Homes benefit if the park owner passes taxes through to them.
items.q: “Yes,” said Duggan. “If certain conditions are met, essentially if the mobile home park owner is passing through their taxes to the mobile home residents, then yes, they would functionally get the Save Our Homes benefit.”
